zh.title: 立法院三讀無人機條例 6年編2400億
zh.summary: 立法院三讀無人機條例；六年編2400億預算；行政院擬副署追加預算
body: 中央社報導，立法院於8月27日三讀通過《強化國防自主暨無人載具產業發展條例》，明定中央政府須連續六年編列總額2400億元預算。
條例訂定主管機關為經濟部，涉及國防軍用採購則由國防部主管；行政院預計9月3日院會副署並編入今年度追加預算，另將提明年度總預算修正案納入無人載具預算。
國民黨團總召傅崐萁指出，台灣具備完整科技製造產業鏈，若政策資源到位，無人載具產業有機會成為全球最大生產基地，創造大量就業與商機。

en.title: Legislature passes UAV act, earmarks NT$240 billion over six years
en.summary: Legislature passes UAV law; six‑year NT$240 bn budget planned, administration to countersign
body: The Legislative Yuan approved the “Strengthening National Defense Autonomy and Unmanned Vehicle Industry Development Act” on 27 August, mandating a six‑year budget totalling NT$240 billion.

The Ministry of Economic Affairs is the competent authority, while defence‑related procurement falls under the Ministry of National Defense; the Executive Yuan intends to countersign the act on 3 September and include funds in this year’s supplementary budget, with an amendment to next year’s budget.

KMT caucus leader Fu Kun‑chi said Taiwan’s complete high‑tech supply chain gives it a chance to become the world’s largest drone production base, generating thousands of jobs and billions of dollars in business.

zh.title: 土耳其航太 Hürjet 量產機完成首飛
body: 土耳其航太（Turkish Aerospace）開發的Hürjet高級噴射教練機，其首架為土耳其空軍生產的量產型已於2026年8月30日完成首飛。
根據AeroTime報導，此架量產型Hürjet在空中的飛行時間為18分鐘。此次飛行是在完成最終組裝、地面測試和滑行測試之後進行。
Hürjet為單引擎、雙座超音速飛機，主要用於高級與導入戰鬥機訓練。航程為1,060海浬，最大速度達1.4馬赫，實用升限為45,000英尺。
此架量產型飛機在交付土耳其空軍前，將持續進行後續的飛行測試與驗證。

en.title: Turkish Aerospace Hürjet production aircraft completes maiden flight
en.summary: First production Hürjet for Turkish Air Force completes 18-minute first flight on August 30.
body: The first production Hürjet advanced jet trainer built for the Turkish Air Force completed its maiden flight on August 30, 2026, according to AeroTime.
The aircraft remained airborne for 18 minutes. The flight followed final assembly, ground testing, and taxi tests.
Hürjet is a single-engine, tandem-seat supersonic aircraft designed primarily for advanced and lead-in fighter training. It has a maximum speed of Mach 1.4 and a service ceiling of 45,000 feet.
The first production aircraft will now undergo further flight testing and verification before delivery to the Turkish Air Force.
